```text
The background sync that keeps this computer up to date

Usage: skillpouch daemon <COMMAND>

Commands:
  start   Start it, and start it again whenever you log in
  stop    Stop it
  status  Is it running, and how did the last sync go?
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
```
